Audit what your coding agents can access. If sudo isn't needed for a task, make sure it's actually unavailable — not just absent by convention. Defense in depth applies to your own dev environment.

What matters for someone building a team right now?

If you're hiring juniors remotely, you need explicit mentorship infrastructure — not ambient learning. Pair programming schedules, explicit knowledge transfer, structured code review. Otherwise you're recreating the problem the FT is describing.

So today's dataset has a thread running through it: automated systems — whether bot detection, coding agents, airline alerts, or AI document pipelines — all have edges that weren't designed for. And the practitioners paying attention are the ones who will build the guardrails.
